description: Estimates one year's federal tax effect of an S corp election for a business owner: self-employment tax without the election versus payroll tax on a reasonable salary with it, minus the income-tax offset (smaller payroll-tax deduction and lost QBI deduction) and the added cost of running an S corp. Uses 2026 Social Security and Medicare figures.

added_costs.description: Extra yearly cost of an S corp (payroll service, the 1120-S return). Defaults to 1500.

filing_status.description: Owner's filing status. Defaults to single.

marginal_rate.description: Owner's marginal federal income tax rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.22. Defaults to 0.22.

net_profit.description: Annual net business profit before any owner salary, in dollars.

salary.description: Planned annual W-2 salary for the owner. If left out, 50% of profit is used as a starting point (not an IRS rule).

name: estimate_s_corp_tax_savings
title: S corp tax savings estimate
